data.hook: David Sandlin had a perfect game rolling into the sixth at Busch Stadium, but a single hit from Nathan Church changed everything fast.
data.name: Cardinals Rally in Sixth to Take Series from White Sox 3-1
data.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals beat the Chicago White Sox 3-1 on Sunday, winning the three-game series with a three-run sixth inning. Rookie David Sandlin carried a perfect game until Nathan Church singled, Masyn Winn followed with a hit, and an error loaded the bases for Alec Burleson's bases-clearing double that proved decisive. Michael McGreevy earned the win with six strong innings, while George Soriano notched the save; the loss dropped Chicago to a half-game lead in the AL Central amid a 10-of-14 skid. St. Louis improved to 74-76, boosting their interleague mark and wild-card hopes.

data.name: Diamondbacks Designate Gurriel for Assignment, Recall Fernandez
data.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks designated veteran outfielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. for assignment on Sunday, recalling infielder Jose Fernandez from Triple-A Reno amid their NL wild card push. Gurriel, 32, struggled with a .210 average and injuries including a torn ACL from late 2025, after shining in 2023 with All-Star honors and 75-plus RBIs in prior years. Fernandez, a 22-year-old who hit .262 earlier this season, returns as the team eyes more chances for young players like Jordan Lawlar down the stretch.
